16001-willy-reilly-the-works-of-william-.title: Willy Reilly The Works Of William Carleton Volume One
16001-willy-reilly-the-works-of-william-.creator: William Carleton
16001-willy-reilly-the-works-of-william-.description: A book by William Carleton. I am agreeably called upon by my bookseller to prepare for a Second Edition of "Willy Reilly." This is at all times a pleasing call upon an author; and it is so especially to me, inasmuch as the first Edition was sold at the fashionable, but unreasonable, price of a guinea and a half--a price which, in this age of cheap literature, is almost fatal to the sale of any three-volume novel, no matter what may be its merits.

58205-the-frontiers-of-language-and-nati.title: In Europe
58205-the-frontiers-of-language-and-nati.creator: Leon Dominian
58205-the-frontiers-of-language-and-nati.description: A book by Leon Dominian. Dominian’s book on “The Frontiers of Language and Nationality” is the logical outcome of the articles written by him in 1915 in the Bulletin of the American Geographical Society under the titles of “Linguistic Areas in Europe: Their Boundaries and Political Significance” and “The Peoples of Northern and Central Asiatic Turkey.” In the present work the problems arising from the distribution of main European languages and from their relation to political boundaries are discussed with clearness and brilliancy.

arxiv-1912-13357.title: A Dynamic Sampling Adaptive-SGD Method for Machine Learning
arxiv-1912-13357.creator: Achraf Bahamou, Donald Goldfarb
arxiv-1912-13357.description: Abstract We propose a stochastic optimization method for minimizing loss functions, expressed as an expected value, that adaptively controls the batch size used in the computation of gradient approximations and the step size used to move along such directions, eliminating the need for the user to tune the learning rate.

arxiv-2105-06840.title: The academic wanderer: structure of collaboration network and relation with research performance
arxiv-2105-06840.creator: PPPavlos Paraskevopoulos, CBChiara Boldrini, APAndrea Passarella, MCMarco Conti
arxiv-2105-06840.description: Abstract Thanks to the widespread availability of large-scale datasets on scholarly outputs, science itself has come under the microscope with the aim of capturing a quantitative understanding of its workings. arxiv-2107-12278.title: Optimizing Topological Switching in Confined 2D-Xene Nanoribbons via Finite-Size Effects
arxiv-2107-12278.creator: Muhammad Nadeem, Chao Zhang, Dimitrie Culcer, Alex R. Hamilton, Michael S. Fuhrer, Xiaolin Wang
arxiv-2107-12278.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Muhammad Nadeem, Chao Zhang, Dimitrie Culcer, Alex R. Hamilton, Michael S. Fuhrer, Xiaolin Wang. In a blueprint for topological electronics, edge state transport in a topological insulator material can be controlled by employing a gate-induced topological quantum phase transition. Here, by studying the width dependence of electronic properties, it is inferred that zigzag-Xene nanoribbons are promising materials for topological electronics with a display of unique physical characteristics associated with the intrinsic band topology and the finite-size effects on gate-induced topological switching.

arxiv-2112-00305.title: Forward Operator Estimation in Generative Models with Kernel Transfer Operators
arxiv-2112-00305.creator: Zhichun Huang, Rudrasis Chakraborty, Vikas Singh
arxiv-2112-00305.description: Abstract Generative models which use explicit density modeling (e.g., variational autoencoders, flow-based generative models) involve finding a mapping from a known distribution, e.g. Gaussian, to the unknown input distribution. This often requires searching over a class of non-linear functions (e.g., representable by a deep neural network).

arxiv-2306-01457.title: Driving Context into Text-to-Text Privatization
arxiv-2306-01457.creator: Stefan Arnold, Dilara Yesilba, Sven Weinzierl
arxiv-2306-01457.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Stefan Arnold, Dilara Yesilba, Sven Weinzierl. Metric Differential Privacy enables text-to-text privatization by adding calibrated noise to the vector of a word derived from an embedding space and projecting this noisy vector back to a discrete vocabulary using a nearest neighbor search. Since words are substituted without context, this mechanism is expected to fall short at finding substitutes for words with ambiguous meanings, such as ’bank’ .

arxiv-2403-05925.title: BEACON: A Bayesian Evolutionary Approach for Counterexample Generation of Control Systems
arxiv-2403-05925.creator: Joshua Yancosek and Ali Baheri
arxiv-2403-05925.description: Abstract The rigorous safety verification of control systems in critical applications is essential, given their increasing complexity and integration into everyday life. Simulation-based falsification approaches play a pivotal role in the safety verification of control systems, particularly within critical applications. These methods systematically explore the operational space of systems to identify configurations that result in violations of safety specifications.

arxiv-2505-21520.title: Do DeepFake Attribution Models Generalize? Conference: 4th ACM International Workshop on Multimedia AI against Disinformation ; June 30-July 3 2025; Chicago, IL, USA 4th ACM International Workshop on Multimedia AI against Disinformation (MAD’25), June 30-July 3 2025, Chicago, IL, USA DOI: 10.1145/37
arxiv-2505-21520.creator: Spiros Baxavanakis, Manos Schinas, Symeon Papadopoulos
arxiv-2505-21520.description: Abstract . Recent advancements in DeepFake generation, along with the proliferation of open-source tools, have significantly lowered the barrier for creating synthetic media. This trend poses a serious threat to the integrity and authenticity of online information, undermining public trust in institutions and media. State-of-the-art research on DeepFake detection has primarily focused on binary detection models.

arxiv-2506-03844.title: Beyond Diamond: Interpretable Machine Learning Discovery of Coherent Quantum Defect Hosts in Semiconductors
arxiv-2506-03844.creator: Mohammed Mahshook, Rudra Banerjee
arxiv-2506-03844.description: Abstract Quantum point defects in wide bandgap semiconductors-such as the nitrogen-vacancy (NV) center in diamond are leading candidates for solid-state spin qubits due to their long coherence times and optically addressable spin states. Yet, identifying host materials capable of supporting such deep-level defects remains a significant challenge, owing to the complex interplay between chemical composition, crystal structure, and electronic environment.

pmc-10528641.title: Regulatory Mechanisms That Guide the Fetal to Postnatal Transition of Cardiomyocytes
pmc-10528641.creator: Patrick G Burgon, Jonathan J Weldrick, Omar Mohamed Sayed Ahmed Talab, Muhammad Nadeer, Michail Nomikos, Lynn A Megeney, Klaus-Dieter Schlüter
pmc-10528641.description: Heart disease remains a global leading cause of death and disability, necessitating a comprehensive understanding of the heart’s development, repair, and dysfunction. This review surveys recent discoveries that explore the developmental transition of proliferative fetal cardiomyocytes into hypertrophic postnatal cardiomyocytes, a process yet to be well-defined.

pmc-10652528.title: The attitudes of postgraduate medical students towards the curriculum by degree type: a large-scale questionnaire survey
pmc-10652528.creator: Xue Jia, Yuyi Zhu, Xuelian Zhong, Qiao Wen, Deren Wang, Mangmang Xu
pmc-10652528.description: BackgroundChinese medical schools have offered both professional and academic degrees for postgraduate students. However, there is limited information about the attitudes of professional-degree and academic-degree students. We aimed to examine the attitudes of full-time postgraduate students towards the curriculum, stratified by degree type.

pmc-10758132.title: QbTest for Monitoring Medication Treatment Response in ADHD: A Systematic Review
pmc-10758132.creator: Urban Gustafsson, Mikkel Hansen
pmc-10758132.description: Introduction:Attention deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD) is considered one of the most common neurodevelopmental disorders in childhood and adolescence. Pharmacological treatment plays an important part in the therapy of the disorder and verifying the effectiveness of ADHD medication is essential throughout the course of treatment.

pmc-11386329.title: Decompression alone or fusion in single-level lumbar spinal stenosis with spondylolisthesis? A systematic review and meta analysis
pmc-11386329.creator: Haiyang Cheng, Gan Luo, Dan Xu, Yuqiao Li, Houzhi Yang, Sheng Cao, Tianwei Sun
pmc-11386329.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). PurposeThe objective of this systematic review and metaanalysis is to compare the efficacy and safety of decompression alone versus decompression plus fusion in single-level lumbar spinal stenosis with spondylolisthesis.MethodsA comprehensive search of the PubMed, Embase, Cochrane Library, and Ovid Medline databases was conducted to find randomized control trials (RCTs) or cohort studies that compared decompression alone and decompression plus fusion in single-level lumbar spinal stenosis with spondylolisthesis.

pmc-12539058.title: Intention to switch from short-acting to long-acting reversible contraceptives among refugee women in Ethiopia: application of the theory of planned behavior
pmc-12539058.creator: Andamlak Gizaw Alamdo, Agnes M. Kotoh, Emefa Judith Modey, Juliana Yartey Enos
pmc-12539058.description: BackgroundThe validity of the theory of planned behavior (TPB) in predicting health behavior intention has proven its applicability to various health behaviors, such as condom uptake, HIV prevention, and contraception use in resource-limited settings. However, the effectiveness of the TPB framework in understanding refugee women’s intention to switch from short-acting contraceptives (SAC) to long-acting and reversible contraceptives (LARC) remains unclear.

pmc-13142088.title: Rhegmatogenous Retinal Detachment Associated With a Retinal Tear Overlying a Choroidal Nevus
pmc-13142088.creator: Georgios Mylonas, Gregor S. Reiter, Markus Ritter, Gabor G. Deak, Adrian Reumueller, Andreas Pollreisz, Stefan Sacu, Michael Georgopoulos
pmc-13142088.description: PurposeThe purpose of the study is to report a case of a rhegmatogenous retinal detachment (RRD) associated with a retinal tear overlying a choroidal nevus.MethodsThis study is a case report.ResultsA 66‐year‐old female patient has been referred to our department because of a retinal detachment in her left eye.

pmc-13477173.title: Using Graphic Medicine to Explore Perceptions of Professionalism in Early Medical Education: A Pilot Study
pmc-13477173.creator: Brittany Rife Magalis, Elkin Galvis, Malavika Prasad, Qi Zheng
pmc-13477173.description: BackgroundLapses in professionalism remain a critical concern in medical education, with early unprofessional behaviors linked to adverse outcomes in clinical practice. Traditional interventions focus on reflection and mentorship, but alternative approaches such as graphic medicine may provide new opportunities for awareness and discussion.

pmc-13590209.title: Cerebrospinal Fluid p75 Neurotrophin Receptor Ectodomain Levels Across Clinically Diagnosed Alzheimer's Disease, Late‐Life Depression, and Healthy Aging: A Preliminary Cross‐Sectional Study
pmc-13590209.creator: Wataru Omori, Naoto Kajitani, Mami Okada‐Tsuchioka, Minoru Takebayashi
pmc-13590209.description: ObjectiveThe p75 neurotrophin receptor ectodomain (p75NTR‐ECD) has been implicated in amyloid‐β‐related neurotoxicity, but cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) levels in late‐life depression (LLD) remain uncertain. We compared clinically diagnosed Alzheimer's disease (AD), LLD, and healthy controls (HC) and reassessed exploratory symptom and cognitive associations.MethodsCSF p75NTR‐ECD was measured in 50 participants (HC, n = 19; LLD, n = 19; AD, n = 12).

pmc-13627668.title: Macroecological pluralism
pmc-13627668.creator: Marco Túlio Pacheco Coelho, José Alexandre Felizola Diniz-Filho
pmc-13627668.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Theory-based and model-based reasoning shape macroecology: one derives models from general principles, the other builds models around data. We argue these are not rival traditions but interacting positions along a continuum of formalization.
